note: La buanderie (s02maison repaint 2026-10-22): laundry room in the NW corner of the ground floor (plan), camera facing north. Blue-grey walls, red-and-cream chequered tiles, white sheets on lines; LANDMARK the big copper laundry boiler on its brick base (left). Left (west) wall: glass door open onto the garden (R_garden). Back wall: window onto the trees, washing machine corner (zoom z1). Right (east) wall: open door to the Delft-tiled kitchen (R_kitchen_01) and the broom cupboard with broom, bucket and a COMPLETE upright vacuum cleaner (zoom z2). Feminine words in the left two-thirds: young woman Cinderella sweeping ash from the boiler firebox (cendre), blank framed plaque for la pipe (museum_text: no pipe painted anywhere; staged display change), butler in a dust cloud at the old armchair (poussière), pig jumping out of a mud tub (boue), poodle sneezing in spilt powder (poudre), muddy spaniel shaking dirt and sand off its coat in the left foreground (saleté). Masculine words on the right: mother with feather duster and mop (ménage), adult maid whisking suds (fouet), girl netting toys off the rag rug (nettoyage). No child near any adult item (there are none).
